source.author: lucan
source.text: tunc primum patuere doli, Numidaeque fugaces Undique completis clauserunt montibus agmen.
source.text_original: tunc primum patuere doli, Numidaeque fugaces / Undique completis clauserunt montibus agmen.
source.text_english: Then at last their stratagems were revealed, and the fleeing Numidians closed in their column, filling the hills on every side.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Mox taciti patuere doli nec vellera curae esse viro, sed sese odiis immania cogi in freta.
reuse.text_original: Mox taciti patuere doli nec vellera curae / esse viro, sed sese odiis immania cogi / in freta.
reuse.text_english: Soon the hidden treachery became clear, and it was no concern to the man that the fleeces existed, but rather that he himself was being driven by monstrous hatreds into the seas.
